# Efforts Folder

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A major space within an Obsidian vault containing notes about action ("what you do"), holding efforts such as areas, interests, and projects.

**Also known as:** Effort Folder

## Scope note

Notes about procedural knowledge, process workflows, periodic routines, regular practices, skills, and activities — "what you do and how it's done". Distinguished from Atlas Folder about knowledge ("what you know"), or Calendar Folder with time-based notes ("when events happened or you did something").
